limits: Controlled scenarios, not observed weather or live traffic.
Traffic: seeded passenger-car demand and inferred signal timings; flat bridge/tunnel elevations.
© OpenStreetMap contributors; Overture Maps Foundation. Heights and architectural detail include estimates.
UAV stations are demonstration sites; canopy and real-world landing access are unverified. Aircraft share paths without fleet collision scheduling.
Traffic uses synthetic demand and inferred junctions with explicit temporary model closures, not observed road closures or measured flows.
Traffic replay covers actual simulation seconds 1–1200; default starts at 600 s. Environmental fields and UAV clocks remain independent.
Traffic has 3 recorded junction collision events and 0 teleports; intersection behaviour remains unvalidated.
Wind model steps are not calibrated physical time; each scenario uses an independent clock. Overlay shows the selected final independent field frames.
Pollution is a 2-D conservative passive tracer with arbitrary uniform road emissions, not a calibrated pollutant forecast.
Flooding uses measured EA terrain only within the core; blank cells have no valid model result, not zero hazard. Depth is shown on a flat display plane, not surveyed 3-D flood surface.
Streamline particles follow SouthKen 60× visual advection, not real-time physical trajectories.
Wind uses a 1 m-trained surrogate directly on 4 m cells, with interpreted dt scaled 4× to 100 s. This is a user-selected scale-transfer assumption, not validated physical similarity.
Wind records all 100 model steps; default sample height is 2 m. Numerical ground is at -2 m; vertical domain extends to 252 m.
Temperature uses a 32 m horizontal / 16 m vertical physical grid, forced by the frozen final wind029 snapshot; its 600 s clock is independent of the scaled surrogate time.
Pollution uses the frozen final wind029 2 m slice over its own 600 s transport experiment; source rates are arbitrary, not observed emissions.
Sunlight and flooding each record 100 computed states across their independent 600 s scenarios; they do not inherit wind model time.
Model trained at1m applied directly at4m peruser assumption; no4³ reduction or upsampling.
Time interpreted100s/modelstep by spatialscale x4; physicalsimilarity notvalidated.
All100 modelsteps independently decoded; no repeated or interpolated frames.
Numericalgroundindex0center−2m solid; firstfluidcenter2m, domainshift unvalidated.

Pretrained surrogate not calibrated CFD or measuredweather.
Controlled clear-sky and20C ambient, not observed weather.
Existing first-order advection/diffusion/linearized radiative balance, not calibrated urban heat model.
Uniform land material/storage/exchange parameters; OSM water prescribed20C, no vegetation evaporation, water thermal inertia or wall radiation.
32m thermal column approximation fills undercrofts; no temperature values in occupied air cells.
Roof conduction is diffusion from prescribed hot solid cells; separate bottom exchange applies only ground-fluid columns, so no duplicate roof exchange.
Advection masks solid upwind interfaces; scalar is advective-form, not a conservative finite-volume heat budget.
Boundary zero-gradient copying is restricted to fluid neighbours; blocked boundary uses ambient.
Frozen wind is specified controlled forcing, not fabricated intermediate wind observations; inherited sourcewind limitations recorded in wind_forcing.
Sky-view factor set1 for diffuse component; geometry shadows only direct component.
